source.note: The community’s condensed edition of Alpöge’s proof (834 files). Chapter assignment beyond “Waves” is a provisional first reading — fix it as you learn more.

foundations.note: Background library (Galois representations, Shimura varieties, class field theory, p-adic Hodge theory, …) the argument stands on. Not part of the pilot.

chapters.title: Waves
chapters.line: The primes are made of waves
chapters.summary: What the hypothesis says, where the zeros show up in a count of primes, and how the proof turns “nothing to the right of the line” into “everything on it”.

chapters.title: A ceiling
chapters.summary: A bound from above on a weighted sum over primes, on far-out stretches of the number line, rules out zeros right of the line.

chapters.title: Multiplicity
chapters.line: Stepanov’s counting trick, for whole numbers
chapters.summary: A number cannot have more prime factors than its size: build numbers divisible by many primes, many times over.

chapters.title: The chain
chapters.line: A chain of theta lifts, √x long
chapters.summary: Each lift adds a layer of divisibility; the chain’s length balances cost against error at the square root.
